title: ISLAMA 01515: Close Encounters in Afghanistan, February 4, 1981
doc_notes: This is a declassified Department of State cable from the U.S. Embassy in Islamabad regarding reports of unidentified high-intensity lights in Afghanistan.

incidents.summary: Reports of high-intensity light phenomena observed in Afghanistan, potentially linked to Soviet military perimeter defense or road security.
incidents.quote: THE RED ARMY IS USING A TYPE OF VERY POWERFUL, HIGH INTENSITY LIGHT THERE.
